paragraphs: In Shevuot 17b, Rava said in the name of Rav Shmuel bar Shava, who said in the name of Rav Huna.

notes.text: The abbreviated authority ר״ה remains unresolved. The consulted Shevuot13a and13b versions did not locate the named Shmuel bar Shava chain; the frozen locator is retained.

The later saved named Davidson Shevuot 17b paragraph explicitly has Rava reporting Rav Shmuel bar Shava reporting Rav Huna. This supports contextual Rav Huna for supplied ר״ה and supplies a matching location alongside the frozen יג., 13a. It does not prove a printer or OCR changed those letters or punctuation. Earlier nonmatches are preserved as history, without expanding an identity graph.

The supplied Hebrew gives Shevuot 13a (יג.). The consulted scan of Hyman (vol. III, p. 1147) appears to give 17a (יז.). The named chain is at 17b in the Davidson edition: Rava reports Rav Shmuel bar Shava in the name of Rav Huna. This supports expanding the abbreviation as Rav Huna in this passage.
